demographics.note: DOSM figures are district-level estimates, in thousands in the source. They are not neighbourhood counts or evidence about an individual walker.

environment.note: Satellite scenes and land-cover products provide environmental context at their published resolution. They do not verify footpath shade, heat, kerbs or working lights.
